text:
leo: Quick idea dump: instead of dual-lease complexity, what if demote writes a short-lived tombstone_stamp on the prefix ledger and prefetch writers must compare their prefetch_epoch <= tombstone_stamp to allow commit. simple compare, no extra acks.
maya: tombstone_stamp = demote_epoch? how do we ensure prefetches in-flight don't race and write older epochs after demote?
leo: prefetch worker flow: read prefix meta -> see tombstone_stamp T -> when finishing prefetch, only write if prefetch_epoch > T. if <= T, abort. so demote fast (writes T), prefetches lose only if older.
raj: That flips earlier model: demote wins by staleness, prefetches self-prune. nice for HOT->COLD transitions. what about the case where prefetch was triggered after demote but still has epoch > T?
ella: then prefetch is actually fresher and should win. but we need to avoid short-lived oscillation: prefetch completes, then another demote writes T'=later epoch and we might thrash. add backoff in prefetch path.
leo: true. add small randomized jitter on prefetch commit retries; also limit reenqueue attempts per prefix per tenant.
maya: perf question: this adds one epoch compare on write path only, not on read hot path. that's good. but index/state store must persist tombstone_stamp atomically with demote.
ops-bot: reminder: ledger writes go through paxos-log-apply; ensure tombstone_stamp is part of the prefix row mutation.
raj: failure modes: what if demote writes T but crashes before notifying local caches? nodes that didn't observe demote might still accept prefetch writes with epoch <= T and resurrect entries. must ensure prefix row is the canonical check during commit, not cache-only.
leo: commit path will re-read prefix row during write prepare and validate prefetch_epoch > tombstone_stamp. do not allow cache-only fast-path commit. micro-penalty but correct.
ella: test plan: 1) unit: commit rejects when prefetch_epoch <= tombstone_stamp 2) integration: simulate demote mid-prefetch, verify no ghost reads 3) chaos: drop ledger apply for demote and observe behavior 4) perf: benchmark extra prepare read cost.
maya: metrics: tombstone_writes_total, prefetch_commits_rejected_by_tombstone, prefetch_retry_backoffs. alert if rejects > 0.5% sustained.
leo: rollout: feature-flag off by default. canary on 2 nodes with tombstone enabled and metric sampling. if stable after 6h, roll to 25% then full.
raj: small nit: need idempotency for demote stamp writes. use demote_uuid + epoch to avoid overwriting newer tombstones with older demotes. only allow stamp update when new_epoch > existing_stamp.
ella: also consider admin tool to scan prefixes with stale tombstones (stuck due to crash) and clear after safety window. include operator playbook.
ops-bot: deploy plan: canary branch: github.com/redwood/inference/eng-runtime/prefetch-tombstone-probe  CI queued
leo: I'll draft a concise RFC follow-up with the commit-flow pseudocode and test harness. tagging @maya @raj for review. :white_check_mark:
